## Summary / 变更摘要

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] Tests added or updated / 已新增或更新测试
- [ ] `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` passes / 格式检查通过
- [ ] No credentials, runtime state, generated binaries, or third-party archives are included / 不包含凭据、运行状态、生成的二进制文件或第三方压缩包
- [ ] Download origins, versions, and hashes remain pinned and reviewed / 下载来源、版本和哈希保持固定且已经审核
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese documentation and third-party notices are updated together / 英文和简体中文文档及第三方声明已同步更新
